projections.source_time_basis: HYCOM instantaneous2022January/July15T00Z;not monthly means or seasonal envelopes.
projections.projection_gate: Interior full-section surface-connected integral maximum and resolved declared primary lower contour;selected model columns do not independently validate named-current axes.
projections.branch_scope: Partial northward Florida Straits25.5–27.5N regional reach, including the27N monitoring latitude. Exclude Gulf of Mexico Loop Current,Antilles flow east of Bahamas,downstream Gulf Stream and family-level Gulf Stream System as target identities. Mainland/Bahamas shallow or dry support can limit the window; broad maxima do not independently establish the current axis. Seabed depth and deepest wet sample are not substituted for a velocity-contour bottom. Existing27N Spray fitted means/phases are separate source context,not simultaneous independent validation.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original fixed-longitude section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use actualnativewrappedlongitude and the declaredlatitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit unresolved reference geometry placeholder with no sampled position or depth. ShortestWGS84legs connect adjacentoriginal references,including across180/-180. Assume linear lowerdepth and paired modelspan only between neighboring original supported nodes;never skip,extrapolate or fill from an alternate cutoff. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current lengths.

projections.projection_gate: Interior full-section surface-connected integral maximum and resolved declared primary lower contour;selected model columns do not independently validate named-current axes.
projections.branch_scope: Partial offshore Portugal Current44–36N and20–12W reach within the Martins2002 statistical-box context. Exclude coastal Portugal Current,coastal countercurrent,slope undercurrents,Azores eastward jet and downstream Canary as target identities. Source mean/error statistics are not instantaneous speed bounds or depth uncertainty. A broad-gate southward maximum may be mesoscale circulation rather than a representative diffuse-current axis. No full current width,core identity or year-round continuity is established.
